document_api_meta.title: Tracking status update
document_api_meta.env_desc:
**This API is currently exclusive to the following markets: US, BR.**
This API is suitable for merchants to deliver and carry orders by themselves, without shipping orders through third-party service providers, that is, without shipping packages through 3PL, but orders sent by merchants. Merchants are allowed to use this API to return such orders and update the order track. The Action Code and Failed Reason in the input parameter are enumerated, as detailed in the document: https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/1cjht3qx

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: external_tracking_url
request_body_param.desc: Service provider's track URL / official website link.

request_body_param.name: tracks
request_body_param.desc: Trajectory node array; maximum number of entries per single request [50], processing results are returned one by one within the array. That is, in the interface, a maximum of 50 tracks can be postbacked per order at a time.

request_body_param.name: ^action_code
request_body_param.desc: The standard trajectory node code must belong to the allowlist. See the below action code. The action code is limited, for the list of available enumerations, please refer to the documentation: https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/1cjht3qx

request_body_param.name: ^occur_time
request_body_param.desc: Actual Trajectory Occurrence Time. Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). The unit is milliseconds.

request_body_param.name: ^description
request_body_param.desc: The original trajectory description of the caller.

request_body_param.name: ^failed_reason
request_body_param.desc: Exception causes, details are listed below. See the below reason code. The reason code is limited, for the list of available enumerations, please refer to the documentation: https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/1cjht3qx

request_body_param.name: ^proof_url
request_body_param.desc: Third-party tracking proof links or credentials.

request_body_param.name: ^location
request_body_param.desc: Location fields such as city, state, province, country, latitude and longitude;

request_body_param.name: ^tracking_no
request_body_param.desc: The waybill number used when placing an order. If there is no tracking code, fill in the invoice id instead. And it may change in split shipment, it may change in different track in this scene.

request_body_param.name: provider_id
request_body_param.desc: The logistics provider ID, which is the one filled in when placing an order or uploading a tracking number, must be consistent with it.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^track_results
response_param.desc: The trajectory node array, where the field in each element of the array indicates which trajectory it is. The `code` and `message` fields describe whether the trajectory has been received; if not, they represent the corresponding error code and error description.

response_param.name: ^^action_code
response_param.desc: The standard trajectory node code must belong to the allowlist. See the below action code.

response_param.name: ^^occur_time
response_param.desc: Actual Trajectory Occurrence Time. Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). The unit is milliseconds.

response_param.name: ^^description
response_param.desc: The original trajectory description of the caller.

response_param.name: ^^code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status of the trace corresponding to this action code, see the below error code

response_param.name: ^^message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in the trace corresponding to this action code. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^^tracking_no
response_param.desc: The waybill number used when placing an order. If there is no tracking code, fill in the invoice id instead. And it may change in split shipment, it may change in different track in this scene.
